title: New meaning allows longing for agreement

captions.physics: Beginning with unexpected questions about hearing
captions.energy: Answering an actual request understood anew
captions.emotions: Feeling attached to a wanted approval

meaning: You can begin with an unexpected question about what was heard and answer an actual request understood anew, acknowledging attachment to approval without making it the only permissible participation.
text: The Fool in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in an unexpected question about what was heard. Judgement in energy supports a wish to answer an actual request understood anew. The Devil in emotions brings attachment to a wanted approval. You can open another course and distinguish a thought understood from a conclusion accepted. An actual response need not immediately remove longing for a particular reassuring phrase.

For example, a habitual “Do you agree with me?” unexpectedly becomes “What did you hear in my answer?” You can notice an actual request for understanding and answer it anew. **A thought heard promises no compulsory approval**. Yet “I completely agree” remains strongly wanted, as though conversation otherwise failed. This attachment can be recognised without cancelling meaning found. A substantial explanation stays genuine even without repeating required words or promising identical assessments of every part not yet named.

Difficulty grows if asking what was heard merely becomes an indirect route to the same wanted agreement. New meaning does not change receiving the answer. Constructive Judgement helps respond to an actual request without automatically restoring its old script. You can want approval and hear another reading; attachment need not disappear immediately, but it does not make every difference proof of misunderstanding or justify demanding continuation until precisely the desired phrase appears.
